content: «Oonikka Woosa Keeththa cima gidana koykko lo7o ooso amottees» giza qaalay tuma.
Hessa gidikko Woosa Keeththe kaaleththizaadey borey bayndaade, issi machcha diza adde, ginara dizaade, bana haarizaade, wogara aqizaade, imath mokkizaade, tamaarsanaas dandayzaade,
maththottonttaade, oosh ooyettonttaade, qasse maarage as, asara palamettonttaade, miish gooddonttaade gidanaas bessees.
Ba nayta azazettizaytanne as bonchchizayta histti dichchidi ba keeththa asaa wogara ayssizaade gidanaas bessees.
Issaadey ba keeththa asaa wogara ayso erontta aggiko Xoossa Woosa Keeththe wostti naagana dandayzee?
Otoreteththan puuridi Xala7ey kundida pirdan izi kundontta mala oorath ammanizaade gidoppo.
Qasseka iza sunththan boretontta malanne Xala7e narxan izi gelontta mala ammanontta asaa achchan lo7o markkateththi daanaas koshshees.
Daaqonetikka hessaththo bonchchettidaytanne ba gida qaalaa laammi laammi yeggonttayta, daro woyne ushshas amottonttayta, ogey baynda go7a gooddonttayta gidanaas bessees.
Ammano xuura, lo7o qofara naaganaas bessees.
Haytantika koyrotti paacettetto; issi iitay istta bolla beettontta aggiko hessafe guye daaqoneteththan ooththetto.
Macca daaqonetikka bonchchettidayta, zigironttayta, qasse wogara dizayta, hano ubbaan ammanettidayta gidanaas bessees.
Daaqoneti issi machchi azina gidanaas bessees; qasseka ba naytanne ba keeththa asaa wogara ayssizayta gidanaas bessees.
Wogara ooththidayti baas gita bonchchonne Yesus Kirstoosan isttas diza ammanon daro xalateth demmana.
Ta neekko elle baana koykkoka hayta azazota nees xaafays.
Ta hanno nees xaafizay ta gam7izaa gidikkoka asay Xoossa Keeththan waani daanaakko ne erana mala gaadakko! Keeththay de7o Xoossaa Woosa Keeththa; hessika tumu tuussinne xapho.
